request: When is the Highway Trust Fund projected to run short of money?
escalation_reason: The quick pass verified only 1 fact(s).

reply.reply: If current revenue and spending trends continue, the Highway Trust Fund’s mass transit account is projected to approach zero in FY2027, followed by its highway account in FY2028 (CRS R48845, PDF p. 14; report dated September 8, 2026). See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-180525-1fa4.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The newest verified CRS finding provides projected zero-balance dates for both Highway Trust Fund accounts and conditions them on current revenue and expenditure trends.
